newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber softens in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber softens in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices softened in late trading on Friday on continued bearish market sentiment, traders said.
They said a deal was done overnight fob Medan at 45.25 U.S. cents/lb for October shipment. Offer prices for September shipment were quoted at 45.00 fob Medan.
"Buyers bid at 44.50 and 44.75 cents in the afternoon, but we were not sure whether they really wanted to buy or were just checking prices," said one trader.
"In general, we are still trying to compete with Thailand and Malaysia, which are offering lower prices. We expect prices to fall again next week because of this situation," he added.
In Palembang, traders offered SIR20 at 44.75 for September/October shipment, but buyers were absent.
Offer prices were quoted at 45.00 fob Surabaya and at 44.00-44.25 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
Some traders said supply of raw material was still tight in a number of centres, but was not impacting prices.

"Buyers usually do not care when we say that supply is tight. They can always choose from which centre they want to purchase rubber. If, for instance, traders in Palembang do not want to sell, buyers can contact those in Medan," said one trader.
